title: Tabarrukat e husaini ka ehteraam karo
body:
Tabarrukat e husaini ka ehteraam karo
husainiyo(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
zamane waalo adab se inhe salaam karo..(2)
tabarukat e hussaini ka ehteraam karo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ye zuljanah yeh taboot ye shabih-e-alam
amanate hai ye zainab ke sab khuda ki kasam
<<DIVIDER>>
inhe sambhal ke rakho na honay do barham
wagarna mehdiye dauraan ko kya bataengay hum
<<DIVIDER>>
bohot he jald ho parda uthanay waala hai
amanate hai ye jiski woh aany waala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tabarukat e hussaini ka ehteraam karo..(2)
2. Jo hum juloos me taboot leke aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zamanay waalo ko shabbiriyat sikhate hai
bani asad ke qabeele ke had badate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheed imam ka taboot yu uthate hai.
jise maraz hai aqeede ka theek hojae
<<DIVIDER>>
jo karbala me nahi tha shareekh hojae
tabarukat e hussaini ka ehteraam karo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jo keh rahe hai tabarruk ghata diya jaye
unhe hamara aqeeda suna diya jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hai woh naam pe sheh ke luta diya jaye
samajh na aaye to yeh mashwara diya jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
jo be jawaaz hai..(2) un khwahisho ko kam kardo
niyaaz ko nahi aasaisho ko kam kardo
<<DIVIDER>>
tabarukat e hussaini ka ehteraam karo..(2)
4. Sanad hai naaqa-e-saleh ka mo'tabar hona
<<DIVIDER>>
agar naseeb hoo hujjat ka humsafar hona
sharaf ko kam nahi karta hai jaanwar hona
<<DIVIDER>>
so zuljanah se munkir ye soch kar hona
har ek lehaaz se tazeem ke ye kaabil hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
ke iska khoon bhi khaake shifa me shaamil hai
tabarukat e hussaini ka ehteraam karo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hussainiyat ke nazar me hussainiyaat alam
nabi ke haath se aaya haath o haath alam
<<DIVIDER>>
hai nasb chauda 14 sadi se labe furaat alam
aur ab imam jo laenge apne saath alam
<<DIVIDER>>
muqassiro ka kaleja jalaya jaega
jab isko kaabe ki chat par sajaya jaega
<<DIVIDER>>
tabarukat e hussaini ka ehteraam karo..(2)
6. Har ek gham ka madawa sagheer ka jhula
<<DIVIDER>>
hayaat baatne waala sagheer ka jhula
kuch isliye bhi hai aala sagheer ka jhula
<<DIVIDER>>
ke hai hussain ka jhula sagheer ka jhula
kiya na radd kabhi koi sawali jhule ne
<<DIVIDER>>
hazaaro jholiya bhardi hai khali jhuke ne
tabarukat e hussaini ka ehteraam karo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jahaa jahaan bhi azaa-e-hussain chalti gai
wahaa wahaa ki saqafat me khud bhi dhalti gai
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne karbala manzar kashi se zinda rakhi
kisi ne dappe azaa ki kahi saji mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
qabeeley ishq ke..(2) manzil ki samt chalte rahe
hussain ek raha qaafile badalte rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
tabarukat e hussaini ka ehteraam karo..(2)
8. takallum itna hai aali makaam farsh-e-azaa
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jaanamaaz-e-azaa-e-imam farsh-e-azaa
ali ki beti ka hai inteqaam farsh-e-azaa
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya hai tune rasoolo ka kaam farsh-e-azaa
yadeediyat me zamane simat gaye hote
<<DIVIDER>>
na bichta tu too musalle lipat gaye hote
sunaa makaam-e-sha'ayar to yeh bhi baat suno
<<DIVIDER>>
samajh ke rasm faqat inko mat sajaya karo
tabarrukaat uthaao magar wuzoo karlo
<<DIVIDER>>
halaal maal hi inpar lage dhyaan rakho
har ek baat ka dekho hisaab dena hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hume hussain ki maa ko jawaab dena hai
author: Mir Hassan Mir
